checkpoint_state.note: cp-01 and cp-02 were already done; cp-03 through cp-05 were already waived with reasons. No pending checkpoint remained for this BA-validation run.

qa.overall_assessment: The corrected BA artifact is materially better than a source/bundle fallback: it enumerates all §5.1-§5.18 rows, requires dev-only desktop and mobile evidence, demands screenshots or accessibility snapshots and console summaries, adds Codex-flavored evidence gates, and preserves the no-daemon-restart/no-production boundary. However, it still shrinks several authoritative Section 5 acceptance criteria into coarse row labels. Because the global spec is the highest authority, the BA artifact is not yet safe as a closure gate.

correction_summary_validation.evidence: Route / Evidence Matrix contains rows for §5.1 through §5.18.

correction_summary_validation.claim: Per-section surfaces and route/sample prerequisites are present
correction_summary_validation.evidence: Every row has a Surface and Route / target prerequisite column, but many prerequisites are generic rather than deterministic sample/card identifiers.

correction_summary_validation.claim: Desktop and mobile requirements are present
correction_summary_validation.evidence: The BA spec states each row must be verified at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844.

correction_summary_validation.claim: Screenshot or accessibility snapshot requirements and console summaries are present
correction_summary_validation.evidence: The BA spec requires screenshot or accessibility snapshot path plus console-error summary for every PASS and FAIL.
False-PASS rules correctly forbid using Claude-tool evidence for Codex items, but §5.15 does not enumerate every individual Codex tool from the user spec.
Affected flows include transcript rendering, tool inline cards, right-side detail panel, sidebar file/path/detail surfaces, markdown renderer, and Codex tool renderers.
Acceptance Criteria require product, navigation, sample_missing, deferred_to_user, or documentation_gap classification.

correction_summary_validation.claim: Work remains dev-only with no daemon restart
correction_summary_validation.evidence: Acceptance Criteria forbid production domain/port use and daemon restart/stop/signal/mutation; Notes require deferred_to_user for daemon-restart requirements.

objections.details: Global §5.17 requires H1-H6, strikethrough, task lists, nested unordered lists, ordered lists, blockquote and nested blockquote, kbd handling, HTML entity decoding, and non-regression for bold/italic/code/links. The BA row only lists H2, H3, list, ordered list, quote, code, table, link, and emphasis.
objections.recommendation: Expand §5.17 into explicit primitive-level checks matching the global spec, including negative/raw-delimiter checks and no-regression checks.

objections.details: Global §5.2 requires every Claude 1M-context variant to display a correct non-degenerate percentage consistent with token usage. The corrected BA row says '[1m] or 1M model sessions with usage data if available', which permits sample absence and does not require all variants.
objections.recommendation: Require an inventory of all surfaced 1M model keys and evidence per key, or classify each missing key explicitly as sample_missing/documentation_gap with no PASS.

objections.details: The global spec says the model changes only when the user manually changes it in the GUI. The BA row covers selected model text, status chip screenshot, and reload persistence, but not implicit changes after re-entry/reload/reconnect/app restart.
objections.recommendation: Add explicit assertions that non-manual events do not alter the per-session model.

objections.issue: §5.4/§5.5 viewport and layout-state coverage is incomplete.
objections.details: Global §5.4/§5.5 require responsiveness across wide desktop, narrow desktop, tablet, mobile, sidebar collapse/expand, split view, and inspector/detail toggles; §5.5 specifically references a second non-adaptive case. The BA matrix only requires desktop and mobile session routes.
objections.recommendation: Add narrow desktop/tablet and right-sidebar/TodoList/detail-open states, or explicitly classify missing states.

objections.issue: §5.15 does not enumerate the user-listed Codex tool inventory.
objections.details: Global §5.15 lists individual tools across web/realtime, local engineering, subagent/delegation, and plugin/parallel categories. The BA row says 'each Codex tool category present', which can false-pass one sample per category instead of every listed tool.
objections.recommendation: Add a tool-by-tool evidence matrix covering every named web.*, functions.*, subagent, tool_suggest, and multi_tool_use.parallel item.

objections.issue: Route and sample prerequisites are not deterministic enough for closure.
objections.details: Rows use phrases such as 'existing dev session', 'if available', 'sample', or 'evidence' without requiring a concrete route pattern, session id, message id, tool-call id, or card identifier before PASS.
objections.recommendation: Require stable route plus sample/card/message/tool identifiers for every row. If no sample exists, classify sample_missing and fail that row rather than allowing PASS.

objections.details: Global §5.10 requires proactive reconnect and causal ordering. The BA row allows deferred_to_user if daemon restart/live daemon change is required, but does not require existing-log/order evidence before deferral and does not define what evidence would prove causal ordering without daemon mutation.
objections.recommendation: Define a non-mutating evidence path, and require deferral to include the exact blocked precondition and user-owned restart/request boundary.

success_criteria_results.criterion: Each §5.1-§5.18 row has desktop and mobile evidence artifact paths.
success_criteria_results.details: The corrected BA spec requires both viewports and artifact paths for future QA evidence.

success_criteria_results.criterion: Every Codex row is verified with Codex-flavored evidence, not Claude-only evidence.
success_criteria_results.details: The false-PASS rule exists, but §5.15 must enumerate every individual Codex tool to prevent category-level false-pass.

success_criteria_results.criterion: Every PASS includes route, sample/card id, viewport, screenshot/snapshot, and console summary.
success_criteria_results.details: The BA spec requires these fields in principle but does not force concrete sample/card identifiers per row and still uses non-deterministic prerequisites.

success_criteria_results.criterion: Failures are classified as product, navigation, sample_missing, deferred_to_user, or documentation_gap.
success_criteria_results.details: The failure taxonomy is explicitly required.

root_cause_verification.rationale: The route/sample evidence-contract gap is partially addressed, but generic prerequisites and narrowed global acceptance criteria still permit false PASS outcomes.

all_findings.issue: Global §5.17 markdown acceptance criteria are missing from the BA matrix.
all_findings.recommendation: Expand §5.17 to all primitives named in the global spec.

all_findings.issue: Global §5.2 all-1M-model coverage is weakened by 'if available'.
all_findings.recommendation: Require per-1M-variant evidence or explicit sample_missing failures.

all_findings.issue: Global §5.15 individual Codex tool coverage can false-pass at category level.
all_findings.recommendation: Replace category-level language with a named tool inventory and evidence row per tool.

self_verification.notes: This was BA-validation only. Evidence consists of the corrected BA spec, corrected context JSON, and global spec Section 5 excerpt; no implementation verification was in scope.
